answer_text: The KB does not state a fixed default value for BGP Hold Time or the Keep-alive interval on a Cato site. Hold Time is the number of seconds the site waits before considering a BGP neighbor down. If two BGP neighbors have different Hold Times, the lower Hold Time is used for both neighbors, and the keep-alive interval is recalculated as one-third of that Hold Time (for example, Hold Time 30 leads to a keep-alive of 10).
